# Version 4.150.0
> **First release on Skia m150** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates the Skia engine to milestone 150 and adds new image and color filter APIs. It adds SKImageFilter crop/empty helpers, an overdraw color filter, and a fast-bounds query on SKPaint, alongside a faster SKSurface canvas path and a raster blur regression fix.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone 150** — Bundles the Skia m150 engine, including a rolled-up batch of upstream chrome/m150 bug fixes, and updates the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190), [#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## API Surface

- **New image and color filter helpers** — Adds SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() and CreateEmpty(), SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() for overdraw visualization, and SKPaint.GetFastBounds() for quick-reject culling. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227), [#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))
- **Legacy pre-v4 obsoletes removed** — Promotes remaining pre-v4 obsolete members to compile errors and trims obsolete enum values from the reference assembly; also drops the deprecated .NET Interactive (Polyglot Notebooks) support. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195), [#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Bug Fixes

- **Raster blur regression fixed** — Defines SK_AVOID_SLOW_RASTER_PIPELINE_BLURS to fix a small-sigma raster blur regression. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Faster SKSurface canvas access** — SKSurface now caches its Canvas wrapper across calls instead of recreating it each time. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.
